content: N sɑnɔ bo ɑ dĩɑ dɔki tiɑ wɑ ɑ di bɔri yɛndu sɔɔ, ye kɑɑ kɑ tɔ̃ɔ bɑkɑ dim di mi sɑnnɔsu wɑ̃ɑ.
Sɔm kowo lɑɑkɑriɡii u rɑ kowɑ win yinnin bii be bɑ ɡeɑ yinɑn wiruɡii, kpɑ u tubi di kɑ be sɑnnu.
Dɔ̃ɔwɑ bɑ rɑ kɑ wurɑ kɑ sii ɡeesu sɔwe, ɑdɑmɑ Yinni Gusunɔwɑ u rɑ tɔnun ɡɔ̃ru wɛ̃ɛri.
Tɔn kɔ̃sowɑ u rɑ tɔn kɔ̃son ɡɑri swɑɑ dɑki, kpɑ wee kowo u mɑɑ weesuɡii swɑɑ dɑki.
Wi u sɑ̃ɑrobu yɛ̃ɛmɔ, Gusunɔwɑ u yɛ̃ɛmɔ wi u bu tɑkɑ kuɑ. Wi u win beruse yɛ̃ɛmɔ yèn sɔ̃ kɔ̃sɑ nùn deemɑ, bɑ koo yɛ̃ro sɛɛyɑsiɑwɑ.
Debuminu nu sɑ̃ɑwɑ durɔ tɔkɔn bɛɛrɛ. Bɑɑbɑbɑ bɑ mɑɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ ben bibun bɛɛrɛ.
Gɑri ɑsɑnsiɡii kun kɑ ɡɑri bɔkɔ weenɛ. Kɑɑ sere ɡere weesu kɑ sinɑ boko?
Gɑbu bɑ rɑ n tɑmɑɑ ben kɛ̃rɑ tɑ koo kɑ bu ɡɑ̃ɑ ɡeenu nɑɑwɑ. Mi bɑ ɡesi duɑ kpuro tu ben bukɑtɑ wunɑnɑ.
Wi u rɑ berusen torɑnu duɑri, u kĩ bɑ n kĩɑnɛwɑ. Wi u rɑ mɑɑ nu yɑɑye win ɡɑri ɡerubu sɔɔ, u bɔrɔnu kɑrɑnɑmɔwɑ.
Gerusibu bu rɑ sɔmburu ko wi u bwisi mɔn mi, n kere bu ɡɑri bɔkɔ bokuru so nɔn wunɔbu (100).
Tɔn kɔ̃so u rɑ n kɑsuwɑ u tɔnu seesi, ɑdɑmɑ bɑ koo nùn tɔn kɔ̃so kpɑre u nùn sɛɛyɑsiɑ.
N burɑm bo ɑ kɑ purukɑ yɔɔni yinnɑ te bɑ buu wɔrɑri, ye kɑɑ kɑ ɡɑri bɔkɔ yinnɑ ɡèn wiirɑrɑ seewɑ.
Wi u rɑ ɡeɑ kɔ̃sɑ dibu kɔsie, kɔ̃sɑ kun kpeemɔ yɛ̃ron yɛnuɔ.
Wi u sikirinɔsu toruɑ, n sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɡe u nim ɡunɑ ɡĩɑ. Yen sɔ̃, ɑ su derio sɑnnɔ ɡu sere tore.
Wi u tɔn kɔ̃so ɡem wɛ̃ɛmɔ, kɑ wi u ɡemɡii tɑɑrɛ wɛ̃ɛmɔ, be kpurowɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u tusɑ.
Mbɑ ɡobin ɑrufɑɑni ɡɑri bɔkɔn nɔmɑ sɔɔ. U koo kɑ yi bwisi dwe? Aɑwo, u ǹ yen bwisi mɔ.
Bɔrɔ kĩnɑsibu bɑ rɑ kĩru sɔ̃ɔsinɛwɑ sɑɑ kpuro sɔɔ. Wɑhɑlɑn sɑɑ sɔɔrɑ mɛro bisi u rɑ somi.
Gɑri bɔkɔwɑ ɡɑ rɑ wure ɡu ɡoon dibu sɔbe.
Wi u rɑ sɑnnɔsu kɑ̃, u rɑ durum kɑ̃wɑ. Wi u rɑ ɡɑ̃ɑnu niɑ ko ni nu nùn kere, u koo kɑm kowɑ.
Wi u rɑ tɔnu nɔni wɔ̃ke, u ǹ nuku dobu wɑsi. Wi u rɑ ɡɑri kɔ̃si ɡere, kɔ̃sɑ yɑ rɑ nùn deemɛ.
Wi u ɡɑri bɔkɔ mɑrɑ, nuku sɑnkirɑnɑ u rɑ n mɔ. Mɛyɑ bii wi u kun ɑsɑnsi mɔn tundo u ǹ kpɛ̃ u n nuku dobu mɔ.
Nuku dobu bu sɑ̃ɑwɑ tìm ɡem wɑsin sɔ̃, ɑdɑmɑ nuku sɑnkirɑru tɑ rɑ wɑsi dɑm dwiiyɑsiewɑ.
Tɔn kɔ̃sowɑ u rɑ nɔm birɑn kɛ̃nu mwɛ u kɑ tɔnu ɡem birɑ.
Lɑɑkɑriɡii, bwisiyɑ u rɑ n nɑɑ ɡire, ɑdɑmɑ ɡɑri bɔkɔ, ɡɑ rɑ n bwisikumɔwɑ ye ɡɑ ǹ wɑsi.
Bii ɡɑri bɔkɔ u rɑ win tundo kɑ win mɛro nuku sɑnkirɑnu kpɛ̃ɛwɑ.
N ǹ weenɛ bu ɡemɡii ɡɑ̃ɑnu bure u kɔsiɑ yèn sɔ̃ u ɡem ɡeruɑ. N ǹ mɑɑ weenɛ bu sunɔ so yèn sɔ̃ u siri dee dee.
Wi u yɛ̃ru mɔ, u ku rɑ ɡɑri ɡere too. Wi u lɑɑkɑri mɔ, u suuru mɔwɑ.
Wi u win nɔɔ kpĩɑ, u bwisi mɔwɑ. Bɑɑ ɡɑri bɔkɔn tii, ɡɑ̀ n mɑɑri, kɑɑ n tɑmɑɑ ɡɑ bwisi mɔwɑ.
